name: @aoc-enterprise/provider-conformance-suite
description: The canonical, provider-neutral Provider Conformance Suite (R005.D): the official compliance harness every future Provider Adapter (Pinata, S3, Azure Blob, Google Drive, SharePoint, Dropbox, or any other) must pass. Defines the certification harness, the canonical execution-result envelope, and provider-SDK import-boundary evaluation logic -- never a provider, an adapter, an SDK, or execution itself.
